payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance metrics comparing NUS and ABUS, indicating how much NUS outperformed ABUS in terms of success rate and average rewards.

claims.text: The best performing policy trained on NUS achieved a 93.4% success rate and 13.8 average rewards, while the best performing policy trained on ABUS achieved a 90.0% success rate and 13.3 average rewards.
The NUS outperformed the ABUS in both evaluation tasks, indicating a consistent performance advantage.
After training for 1000 dialogues, the average success rate of policies trained on NUS was 97.3% compared to 94.0% for those trained on ABUS.
